approval.note: Interpretation of a general instruction: the sealing, the decision rules and the unseal of 2014-2016 are recorded as the owner's authorised plan; the owner may withdraw it. The measured reforecast download (about 40 GB) was larger than the 20-25 GB estimate given when the scope was confirmed.
approval.record: owner instruction of 2026-10-03: 'now try to close those two requirements download search data that is needed and proceed and implement both requirement properly', with the data scope confirmed in chat: GEFSv12 reforecast control 2000-2016 with 2014-2016 sealed, and ERA5 1.5 degree geopotential 2000-2023

data.forecast: GEFSv12 reforecast control member c00, 00 UTC, Days 1-3 rainfall (canonical 24 h reconstruction on the 49x49 target grid) and six atmospheric fields, built by scripts/build_reforecast_forecast_side.py
data.observation: IMD RF25 daily rainfall, official 0.25 degree files, hash-pinned (regime_validation_protocol_v1 climatology file hashes); IMD files stay local, only aggregates are tracked
data.reanalysis: ERA5 geopotential from the public WeatherBench2 store (1.5 degree, 6-hourly, 13 levels), used ONLY to label past days; never a forecast input (AGENTS.md section 3.5)

forbidden: reading any sealed-year observation, label or reanalysis value before the unseal record exists
using 2014-2016 for fitting, tuning, threshold choice, feature choice or selection
changing the grid, rules, thresholds or tiers after any validation result is seen without a new protocol version
pooling with the 2017-2019 reforecast years or the operational years
using ERA5 or any observation as a model input
claiming skill from the validation years as final evidence

labels.sealed: POST-UNSEAL SEALED TEST 2014-2016: first use of these years
labels.validation: validation years 2012-2013: development evidence, used for selection

populations.note: The sealed years 2014-2016 are untouched: no earlier model, selection or experiment of this project used them. 2017-2019 (Track A) and 2021-2025 (Track B) are NOT used here. The reforecast lineage (GEFSv12 retrospective) is never pooled with the operational track.

purpose: Two pre-registered questions on an independent, much longer GEFSv12 reforecast corpus (control member, June to September, 2000-2016): (R05) does a corrected forecast improve on Raw GEFS for rainfall error, heavy rain and very-heavy rain on years no earlier model or experiment has seen, and does regime-awareness add value over the best non-regime model; (R03) can regime states (active, break, low/depression, western disturbance, coastal/orographic rain) be detected from the forecast alone against labels that are independent of the forecast-time rules.

classifier.baseline: the same model on lead hours, day-of-year sine and cosine only (a climatology)
classifier.family: standardised logistic regression, one per task
classifier.operating_point: the validation-year threshold that maximises balanced accuracy
classifier.selection: validation-year AUC (training years only for fitting)

coverage_mapping.REGIME-CLASSIFIER: IMPLEMENTED only if ACTIVE, BREAK and LOW_DEPRESSION are all VALIDATED
coverage_mapping.REGIME-COASTAL-OROGRAPHIC: IMPLEMENTED only if COASTAL_OROGRAPHIC is VALIDATED
coverage_mapping.REGIME-WESTERN-DISTURBANCE: IMPLEMENTED only if WESTERN_DISTURBANCE is VALIDATED
coverage_mapping.otherwise: the row stays PARTIAL and says which tasks were not validated
coverage_mapping.wording: validated against objective labels, never against an expert analysis; the western-disturbance label compares a forecast trough with a reanalysis trough, so it largely verifies the forecast height field

features: forecast western-disturbance indicator (500 hPa geostrophic vorticity over 25-38 N, 62-78 E from the forecast height)
r03.label_nature: objective, rule-based, reanalysis- or IMD-derived labels in the style of the published trackers; NOT the published classifications and NOT an expert analysis; the percentile labels are relative by construction
r03.label_time: the valid day of the case: initialization date plus the lead day

sealed_test.support_gate: at least 30 positive and 30 negative cases in the sealed test per task, otherwise insufficient support and no verdict

tiers.VALIDATED: AUC lower bound above 0.5 and the AUC difference over the climatology baseline has a lower bound above zero

tasks.ACTIVE: IMD core-zone rainfall active spell (July and August; 1981-2011 climatology; +1 standard deviation; three days)
tasks.COASTAL_OROGRAPHIC: IMD mean rainfall over the Ghats-coast zone cells at or above the training-years 85th percentile (June to September days)
tasks.LOW_DEPRESSION: ERA5 850 hPa geostrophic vorticity box maximum, 15-25 N, 70-95 E, at or above the training-years 85th percentile, on at least two consecutive days
tasks.WESTERN_DISTURBANCE: ERA5 500 hPa geostrophic vorticity box maximum, 20-36.5 N, 60-80 E, same rule

coverage_mapping.IMPROVEMENT-VS-RAW_becomes_IMPLEMENTED_o: a selected arm reaches tier FULL on the sealed test; otherwise the row stays PARTIAL and states which of the three improvements were and were not shown
coverage_mapping.regime_wording: regime-awareness is claimed to add skill only if regime_adds_value is true

grid.event_weight: w = min(cap, 1 + y / 64.5) from the observed rainfall of a training row; cap None means no weighting

model_spec.gpu: not used (the earlier equivalence gate was not met)
model_spec.note: the same fixed settings as the geography-aware follow-up protocol

B1.role: adds the eight static geography columns

regime_arms.R_hard: M3-style hard routing to three regime experts
regime_arms.construction: pseudo-labelling rule fitted on the training cases (Phase 2A method), logistic classifier on the 12 regime features fitted on the training cases, three experts trained with the SELECTED B0 configuration, an expert with fewer than 100000 training rows falls back to the global B0 model

also_reported: FSS is not part of this study
comparisons: each selected global arm (B0, B1) against Raw
R_soft and R_hard against B0 (does regime-awareness add value)

decision.BIAS_OK: |bias| <= 1.5 mm and heavy and very-heavy frequency bias within the selection limits
decision.IMPROVES_HEAVY: heavy-rain CSI difference positive with the 97.5 percent interval excluding zero
decision.IMPROVES_RMSE: RMSE difference against Raw negative with the 95 percent interval excluding zero
decision.IMPROVES_VERY_HEAVY: very-heavy CSI difference positive with the 97.5 percent interval excluding zero
decision.regime_adds_value: heavy CSI improves over B0 with the 97.5 percent interval excluding zero and the RMSE difference interval upper bound is at most 0.2 mm
decision.tiers: FULL = all three improvements and BIAS_OK; RMSE_AND_HEAVY; PARTIAL; NONE

sealed_test.intervals: 95 percent for RMSE, 97.5 percent (Bonferroni over the two thresholds) for heavy and very-heavy CSI differences
sealed_test.support_gate: at least 30 observed event pairs per threshold in the sealed test, otherwise that threshold is reported as insufficient support and cannot count as an improvement
sealed_test.unit: initialization date (whole dates resampled, 2000 resamples, seed 26080)

selection.choice: highest mean of heavy and very-heavy CSI; ties go to the lower RMSE, then the earlier grid position; none eligible means no candidate and the study reports that
selection.data: validation years only, models trained on the training years only
selection.eligible: RMSE no worse than Raw, heavy CSI at least Raw's, |bias| <= 1.5 mm, heavy frequency bias <= 2.0, very-heavy frequency bias <= 3.0
selection.refit: the selected configuration of each arm is refit on training plus validation years (2000-2013) before the sealed test; nothing else changes
